purpose: Review-preservation, source-bound strategic evidence and bounded latency experiment

changes.preservation: At most three original, independently admitted subspans in the existing semantic response. Strict sentence/source identity guards; complete Oracle fallback supplements surviving facts. Parent uncertainty remains.
changes.limitations: Subspan admission intentionally covers only narrow locally checked printed properties and exact complete quotations. General strategic subclaims and dependent references abstain.
changes.mana: Canonical local snapshot-bound Kinnan evidence, exact official rules/ruling dependencies, distinct source and additional mana restrictions/riders. Conditions do not assert available resources or strategic superiority.
changes.resources: Exact fixed activation-mana per draw arithmetic for isolated supported abilities. Colored requirements remain separate; energy/taps/life/sacrifices have no exchange rate. No pruning or learned ranking.
changes.wire: After candidate/enrichment packing freezes, share identical scope text and alias repeated evidence/condition reference keys. Whole source identities, offsets and hashes remain reconstructable. Freed bytes do not expand the shortlist.
changes.knowledge: Permission/review workflow with signed content-bound receipts, trusted registry validation, full stored manifests and read-only provenance/content audit.
changes.evaluation: Ten frozen AI-authored development cases; capture-time suite hash required. Missing judgments never earn success. Human independence and expert validation remain absent.

wire_scope: Synthetic offline fixtures only; bytes exclude system/schema. No transport latency or quality gain inferred.

regression_checks.adversarial_runtime: two rounds; final bounded clearance, 93 focused tests
